data.title: Kubernetes
data.description:
[Kubernetes](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/), also known as K8s, is an open source system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

Kubernetes builds upon [15 years of experience of running production workloads at Google](https://queue.acm.org/detail.cfm?id=2898444), combined with best-of-breed ideas and practices from the community.
